programs.title: Programs
programs.text: We offer a variety of programs to help children in underserved and underdeveloped communities in Africa.

programs.title: AI for All
programs.text: Internationally accredited AI training for Nigerian teachers, delivered with Tech She Can and Microsoft. Free, CPD-certified, and built for every subject.

photo.alt: A facilitator presenting a lesson on screen

programs.title: Educators Program
programs.text: We provide free tech lessons to educators in Africa to help them teach their students better.

photo.alt: An educator explaining a concept to her class

programs.title: Kids Program
programs.text: We provide free tech lessons to kids in Africa to help them learn better.

photo.alt: Pupils crowding in for a photo during a school visit

founder.title: Changing what a child can imagine for themselves
founder.quote: I founded OpenKids Africa to help bridge the digital skills gap across Africa by giving children in underserved communities early exposure to technology, equipping them with the skills and awareness to explore future opportunities, while encouraging more girls to see themselves in technology.
founder.name: Regina Nkenchor

volunteer.title: Volunteer with us
volunteer.text: OpenKids Africa Education Champions are passionate volunteers dedicated to delivering tech lessons to children in rural schools using our combined free digital resources.

photo.alt: A volunteer leading a hall of pupils with their arms raised

faqs.content: You can donate to us through our website by clicking the 'Donate' button on the top right corner of the page. Additionally, we offer the option to donate via PayPal for added convenience.

Absolutely! If you prefer to donate via check, please reach out to us at openkidsafrica@gmail.com, and we will promptly provide you with the required details. Your commitment to empowering young minds in Africa is making a significant difference. Thank you for being a crucial part of our mission!

faqs.topic: I am an aspiring educator but have not taught in school, can I apply?
faqs.content: Yes, aspiring educators are encouraged to apply and gain experience through our program.

cta.title: Support the future of children in rural African schools
cta.text: Every month, your contribution plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of African children by providing access to our free tech lessons.
